summary.headline: Angelicus 74 Astrological Codex
summary.text: Catalog entry for Angelicus 74, a fifteenth-century paper codex in Matthaeus Devaris’s hand, formerly owned by Iohannes Lascaris. It describes an anonymous commentary on Ptolemy’s Tetrabiblos, Porphyry’s introduction with Demophilus’s scholia, fragments of Hephaestio, astrological material on heavenly dispositions and revolutions, and a diagram of the twelve zodiacal signs and their configurations; appended notes discuss Muhammad’s preaching and Yathrib.
